{{Aries}}
Aries 7 is the 119th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 7th day of Aries, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 17, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 5宮7日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 119|Chapter 119]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152139}}.
